episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her journey of using YouTube as a powerful lead generation tool in real estate. Despite initial challenges, her commitment to consistent content creation led to significant business growth. The discussion highlights the importance of hiring an editor, maintaining perseverance, and the unique client relationships formed through YouTube.
